Invia Flights

Three moments that decide a flight booking

go.fluege.de is one of the largest flight booking sites on the German market. I looked after the booking funnel and owned three features end to end, each answering a doubt right where it comes up. Every change had to prove itself on UX KPIs in A/B tests.

Design to Code

A design system as the single source of truth

A design system for safety-critical software had grown for years without tokens, and parts of it lived only in code. In three months I helped make Figma the single source of truth, including a token workflow straight into code with QA, ready for AI.

Prime League

An esports platform people can follow

Prime League is one of the largest League of Legends competitions in the DACH region, with 1,500+ teams and 6,000+ players every season. I researched why people got lost and rebuilt the structure around the one question everyone had: when and where is the next match?

The common thread

Honest beats pushy.

Not the usual route into design

In restaurants I learned to notice an unhappy guest before they say anything. Science got me used to checking assumptions with data. And live commentary means explaining a chaotic game in plain words, in real time.

Today, with six years in UX, I work as a UX/UI and product designer in Berlin, freelance and open to selected roles. I design products across B2B SaaS, travel and gaming, and I build the systems that keep them consistent.
